results.rationale: The three-drawer cabinet and knobs are retained with a minor proportional change. A white wall, wood floor and linen curtain create the intended setting, but the title is bold rather than thin and garbles but also into buso; distinct angled sunlight is weak. The furniture and room are coherent, while the malformed text is a noticeable semantic flaw.

Symbols in all four existing grids are changed. The two empty grids become dense checkerboards of fragmented symbols instead of 3x3 grids with X and O interchanged, so the specified swapping logic is absent. Corrupted symbols and incompatible grid subdivision severely damage the worksheet. Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid.
